text:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Software Development Engineer I position at Cobalt Fintech. As a recent graduate with a B.E. in Information Technology from Western Ghats College of Engineering and hands-on backend development experience, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. 

During my recent internship as a Backend Developer at Ledgerly Payments, I built REST APIs in Java 17 and Spring Boot for merchant settlement reports. I also wrote PostgreSQL queries and Flyway migrations, successfully cutting the run time of the slowest report from 9 seconds to 1.2 seconds through targeted database indexing. Additionally, my work involved adding Kafka consumers to process payment events, writing associated JUnit tests, and participating in the team's on-call rotation for two months. 

My technical foundation extends to building projects such as a library management system using Spring Boot, MySQL, and JWT authentication deployed on AWS EC2, as well as a URL shortener in Go with Redis caching that was load-tested to 2,000 requests per second. I have also strengthened my problem-solving abilities by solving over 400 problems on competitive programming sites. My skill set includes Java, Spring Boot, Go, SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and Kafka.

I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend development experience and technical background align with the needs of Cobalt Fintech. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
